text:
Mia: @here quick FYI — main turned red right after the fast-merge from release/rollup-2026-03-17. gateway-e2e timed out. Can someone grab this? :eyes:
ci-bot: pipeline main #4827 FAILED — step: gateway-e2e (timeout after 10m). logs: https://ci.internal/red/4827 
Sam: which test exactly timed out? flaky or full e2e?
ci-bot: failing task: tests/integration/gateway/test_gateway_endtoend.py::test_streaming_connect — hung on step 'handshake' 
Jen: on it, going to kick a rerun now.
Jen: rerun command: `ci retry 4827 --stage gateway-e2e`
deploy-bot: rerun started by Jen — job id 4827.1 (queued)
Alex: if rerun fails again we should bisect last two merges (rollup + a docs PR that touched test harness). The harness change looked small but could affect timeouts.
Sam: grabbing artifacts now. where are the full logs?
ci-bot: artifacts: https://ci.internal/red/4827/artifacts.tar.gz (10MB) — trace at tests/integration/gateway/handshake.log 
Priya: I pulled logs — looks like repeated `ReadTimeoutError` while waiting for mock upstream. Could be a local infra flake or a newly introduced race.
Mia: hold merges for ~15m? we don't want another fast-merge to make noise.
Jen: rerun finished — still failed, same hang at 4m 12s.
Alex: ok bisect time. @Sam can you grab the exact commit range between the previous green and this merge?
Sam: range is: commit a1b2c3d..f9e8d7a (includes rollup + harness tweak). Starting bisect on a fresh worker.
Priya: note: the harness tweak changed socket timeouts from 60s -> 30s in one helper; that could explain faster timeouts but weird that e2e times out earlier than before.
Jen: I'm spinning a debug run with increased logging and a widened timeout to confirm. command: `ci run debug 4827 --env TEST_TIMEOUT=120`
ci-bot: debug job started — id 4827.debug (live logs: https://ci.internal/red/4827/debug)
Mia: thanks. if debug still fails, let's coordinate a quick paired debug session — @Alex @Priya available?
Alex: I can join in 10. ping me in thread when logs are ready.
Priya: I can be on call now.
Sam: downloaded artifacts and grepping: 
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tests/integration/gateway/test_gateway_endtoend.py", line 142, in test_streaming_connect
    resp = client.perform_handshake()
  File "tests/support/mock_client.py", line 58, in perform_handshake
    if not self.sock.recv_ready(timeout=30):
TimeoutError: socket recv timeout
```
Jen: that `timeout=30` is exactly where the harness change could bite. debug run will confirm if increasing it avoids the hang.
Mia: decision for now — block merges, keep alert on debug job. assign owner: Jen (primary), Alex (backup). If debug shows harness is the culprit, revert harness tweak and ship a targeted fix.
Priya: adding an eval note: run local gateway mock 50x to reproduce. I'll start a small load run.
Sam: noted, I also opened a ticket: INFRA-319 (bisect + artifact links).
Mia: thanks all — update in 20m or earlier when we have debug results. :thumbsup:
